name: Custom Minimal Agent Runtime
mechanism: Implements one application-owned model and tool loop with typed state, deterministic stop rules, hard budgets and explicit policy boundaries.
use_when: The workflow is narrow enough that the entire control loop remains auditable
The application needs exact control without graph or harness abstractions
avoid_when: Runs require durable pause and resume across process failure
The team is beginning to rebuild generic checkpoint, sandbox, streaming or concurrency infrastructure
expected_effects: Direct ownership of policy state and failure behavior
failure_modes: State migration and cancellation logic remain incomplete
Observability and provider edge cases accumulate without dedicated ownership
